tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs la phrin las bskul ba 'jigs rung rdo rje'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ na mo gu rwa mo gha siddhā ya// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje'i gsang gsum gyi// chu gter gdug pa 'dul byed mandā ras// bsrubs skyes snying po bstan srung nyin mor byed// gur mgon chen po lha mo 'dod khams bdag /stong zil lhun por bskal pa'i mtshun za ches// lan brgyar dkris pas 'gran min 'jigs rung gzugs// gdong bzhi dpal mgon gsod byed sring bzhi dang*// snang srid dregs pa'i bran 'khor grangs med bcas// dam nyams kun gyi snying rtsa rbad kyis bcad// khrag dron hub tu btung la ches rngam pa'i// las byed shan pa gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra bha ṭa srin mo ru 'dren sde// dgra bo'i dbugs len sha za dur khrod bdag /dgra shar rngam pa'i dmag zor re ba tī// khams gsum 'gro ba'i srog bdag chos kyi rgyal// 'khor dang sprul pa yang sprul dpag yas bcas// sngon dus rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa// bdag sogs yongs 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon bar du// rim par brgyud pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma'i bkas// bsgos don bstan pa gnyer gtad dran byon la// 'dzam bu ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling mchog 'dir// mdo sngags bstan pa'i dgongs 'grel legs bshad kyis// sgrib pa'i mun 'phrog 'di nas byang chub bar// lam kun legs par 'doms mdzad sa skya pa// de rigs sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul lha rigs gdung*// gangs can bstan 'gro'i mgon du mi chad rgyun// la gor 'byon pas 'jig rten bde legs dang*// sde bzhi phun tshogs sgo mangs phye mdzod cig /'khrul bral bzhed pa smra mchog 'dzam gling 'dir// thub pa'i rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang po pa'i// bstan pa de 'dzin rnams kyi phrin las bcas// dbyig 'dzin 'khor lo yongs khyab rgyas par mdzod// lugs mchog rjes 'jug grangs med ngur smrig 'chang*// 'dus pa'i dmar mdangs phyogs kyi bu mo'i bzhin// bkab pa'i bshad sgrub rin chen 'byung gnas rlabs// srid pa'i rtse mor lud snyam nyid du mdzod// sa skya'i rje btsun e waṃ par bcas pa'i// bstan pa la 'tshe bstan 'dzin sku dgrar byed// rjes 'jug phrin las mnga' thang 'phrog byed pa'i// bstan dgra blo ngan gang du gnas pa der// bstan srung dbang po dregs pa'i sde tshogs bcas// sdang dgrar khros pa'i sprin nag glog dmar 'khyug

/hūm̐ phaṭa nga ros 'brug sgra 'bum ldir zhing*// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi ser char phob// mthu stobs thog brgya 'khrugs pa'i stobs bskyed la// bstan dgra dam nyams bsam ngan rjes 'brangs bcas// lo zlar 'gyang skabs med par bzung bcing bsnun// gcod gsod drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod mdzod// ngan smra'i rdul 'thor sdang sems gdug sems 'chang*// phyi nang gang du gnas de'i bsod nams tshe'i// lhag ma tshur phrogs rnam shes skye med dbyings// bsgral ba'i phrin las bstan srung yongs kyis sgrubs// bstan dgra bsgral la bka' srung mthu ma chung*// bdag gis bstan don bskul ba chud ma gsan// phyi rabs sngags 'chang snying la sun ma dbyung*// sod rtags don snying dmar po skyes su stsol// bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa'i dal rten la// gnam lo zla ba zhag dang dus tshod kyi// 'byung tshogs dgra gshed babs pa'i keg 'phrang sri// na shi dur sgo bye ba bzlog cing bsgyur// phrag dog rgyud 'khrugs dgra bo'i bsam sbyor las// rtsub mor mngon brtsams byad gtad rbad zor gyi// gnod pa thams cad byad mkhan de de'i thog /bzlog bsgyur lha srung bdud du dbab par gyis// bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam thugs rje dang*// dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu rtsal bsam mi khyab// bdag cag bstan phan lhag bsam bden stobs kyis// smras don snye ma g.yur du za bar shog /ces bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs la phrin las rgyud nas bskul ba 'jigs rung rdo rje'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sga stod phyogs kyi chos rje mkhas btsun chen po bkra shis dpal bzang pa'i gsung gis rgyun du 'don byar 'di bzhin dgos zhes snga phyir bskul ba'i ngor/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung nyi ma'i mig dmar gyi gnam lo'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling gi bsti gnas su sug bris bgyis pa sarba di gbhyo bi dza ya tu//

// ༄༅// bstan pa cher rgyas kyi 'dod gsol bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs don legs 'grel ba'i// blo chen sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// chos srid phrin las 'dzam gling gser ldan ma'i// dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par rgyas mdzod cig /de tshul sbyangs pa'i blo gros dkyil 'khor can// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i nyin byed mang 'byon pas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od stong rab 'gyed cing*// skye dgu'i bsod nams dgung dbus brtan par mdzod// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshogs// grangs med phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khur lci bas// bshad sgrub lhur len bsnyen bkur sbyin bdag gi /mnga' thang dpal 'byor lhan cig rgyas par mdzod// ces skabs rer smon lam du 'don na tshig gi mtha' rnams gyur cig ces bsgyur bas 'thus so// zhes bstan pa cher rgyas kyi 'dod gsol bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun chos kyi rje ye shes phun tshogs pa'i gsung gis gtor bsngo bskang gso sogs kyi skabs su 'don bya 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs rgyas par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bka' srung rnams la phrin las bskul ba brtsams don 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang sogs dngos brgyud bla ma'i bkas// bstan pa gnyer gtad srung ma'i sde dpon che// gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi yum chen bzhi// pu tra ming sring dur khrod dmag zor sogs// bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i chos srung drag rtsal tshogs// bshams sprul phyi nang mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// sa ngor bstan pa'i bshad sgrub khur khyer ba'i// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas par mdzod// lugs bzang rjes su sgrub pa'i ngur smrig 'chang*// dpag yas 'dus pa'i khur gyis 'dzam gling yongs// ngal bar ma bzod bshad sgrub spel ma'i dbyangs// snyan dgu shugs ring 'byin snyam nyid du mdzod// bstan don sgrub pa'i gegs 'phrang dug can gnas// zab mo'i 'jigs las bka' srung ded dpon gyis// legs bsgral gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis kyi// nor bu lag rtser thob pa'i dngos grub stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas gzhan don du// thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub phyir thos bsam dang*// bsgom byung yang dag rtogs pa'i blo gros rtsal// rnam dkar phrin las ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe// bsod nams bde 'byor lhan cig rgyas par mdzod// sgo gsum dge bar bar du gcod byed pa'i// phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs nad dang gdon kun dang*// mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe'i rigs// bstan srung dran pa'i 'phral nyid zhi bar mdzod// zhi bas gdul dka'i sdang dgra byad gtad kyis// gnod byed kun gyi las ngan rgyun gcod phyir// bsad bcad bsgral nas rnam shes dbyings sbyor ba'i// phrin las dam can srung ma'i tshogs sgrubs shig

/ces bka' srung rnams la bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las rjes su bskul ba brtsams don 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan srung dbang pos rjes su gzung ba'i chos kyi rje dam pa de nyid kyi gsung gis bskang bshags dus su gdon byar 'os pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ lha srung gdams pa'i nor can bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs su bris pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bka' srung gnyen po rnams kyi thugs dam rgyud nas bskul ba'i tshigs bcad bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// sarbārtha siddhirbha wa tu/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i gsang gsum yon tan gyi// sgyu 'phrul las skyes gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gnyan mgon chen po zhal bzhi sring bzhi dang*// zhing skyong dregs pa'i sde tshogs 'khor dang bcas// bstan dgra'i srog gcod gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra bha ṭa srin mo kha 'bar ma// dur khrod sha za ru 'dren dmag zor dang*// las kyi gshin rje beg tse lcam dral sogs// dpal mchog rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa// bdag gi 'dren mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i bar// rim par byon pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma yis// bka' bsgos bstan pa gnyer gtad dran byos la// 'dzam gling chos kyi snang ba rab 'gyed cing*// 'jig rten dge legs 'gugs byed sa skya pa'i// bstan pa bstan 'dzin gdung brgyud chos brgyud bcas// mi 'chad bskal par rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// de tshul 'doms pa'i rgyal po e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang smra mkhas grangs med gser ldan khur// rnam par lci bas 'chad rtsod brtsad gsum gyi// snang bas srid pa'i mun stug bcil bar mdzod// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug ngur smrig 'chang tshogs kyis// bsil ldan ljongs kun khyab par rgyas 'gyur zhing*// bslab gsum lhur len bshad sgrub zung 'jug gi

/rgyal bstan ring 'tsho'i sman pa mchog tu sgrubs// de dag bstan par sman 'dogs brtson bdag kyang*// ring 'tsho bde ldan tshangs ris gzugs kyi zla// phyi nang yon tan rgya mtsho'i gnyen por 'phel// phrin las nyi 'od dgra zlar rgyas par mdzod// yul gru 'dis mtshon rgyal khams thams cad du// skye 'gro'i gsos gyur lo thog legs smin pa'i// mthun rkyen bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun chen pos// rdzogs ldan dus bzang dga' ston spyod par mdzod// bstan pa bstan 'dzin bstan pa'i rjes 'jug bcas// legs phyogs 'phel la gegs byed sdang sems dang*// bsam sbyor gdug pa'i bstan dgra tsher ma'i nags// de ltar gang nas gzing yang mkhyen bzhin du// mthu stobs dus mtha'i zhugs lce 'bum brkyangs la// lo zlar 'gyang skabs med par da lta nyid// dug mtshon nad kyis lus la cher bsnun cing*// lhag med gzhob tu bsregs nas brlag par mdzod// yid srubs snying zhugs pha rol bsam sbyor dbal// rtsub mos brtsams pa'i byad gtad rbad zor gyi// nyer 'tshe thams cad byad mkhan de de'i thog /bzlog bsgyur lha srung bdud du dbab par gyis// bka' srung khyed cag mthu dang rtsal ma chung*// rnal 'byor bdag gis byas pa chud ma gsan// phyi rabs sngags 'chang snying la sun ma dbyung*// gang bcol snye ma la gor smin par mdzod// bla ma lha yi byin rlabs thugs rje dang*// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho mthu nus dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam bden pa'i stobs dag gis// smras don lhun gyis 'grub pa nyid gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung gnyen po rnams kyi thugs dam rgyud nas bskul ba'i tshigs bcad bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di'ang bstan don spyi'i gegs sel dang char 'bebs kyi rim gro thun mong gi phyir bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge'o//

// ༄༅// bstan srung dbang po rnams la las bcol bstan dgra'i snying dmar 'byin pa'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi /'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon gyi bar byon pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig la// rjes su dgongs pa'i bstan srung khyad par can// rdo rje ma hā kā la lcam dral dang*// dpal mgon zhal bzhi gtum po sring bzhi dang*// zhing skyong dregs pa'i sde tshogs thams cad dang*// las byed mgon po gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra bha ṭa sring mo kha 'bar ma// dur khrod yab yum ru 'dren sde dang dpung*// dmag zor las kyi gshin rje'i 'khor tshogs bcas// bstan dgra'i srog gcod bstan srung rgya mtsho dgongs// mdo sngags bstan pa'i dgongs don smra ba'i dbang*// brtse chen kun dga' snying po e waṃ pa// rnam gnyis lugs bzang 'dod 'byung nor bu'i rgyal// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor brtan par mdzod// bdag cag slob 'khor bcas pa'i lus ngag yid// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi nu zho nyer btung bas// lung rtogs yon tan lang tsho bskyed bsrings la// nad gdon bar chad bsrung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// bstan 'gror phan pa'i bsam sbyor brtson gang la// sdang sems bsam sbyor rtsub mo'i las rtsom pa'i// sdang dgra byad ma'i rigs gyur gang yod pa// ye shes gzigs par gsal la smos ci 'tshal// gnod byed de dag phrag dog mi dge'i sdig /rgyun chags gcod phyir lor zlar ma 'gyang bar// rmugs rmongs 'thibs kyis ltas ngan cho 'phrul thong*// lus ngag yid kyi mthu nus nyams zad gtugs// bsod nams tshe yi lhag ma yongs phrogs nas// srog rtsa chod la don snying dmar po phyung*// bsad bcad bsgral nas rnam shes dbyings sbyor ba'i// gang 'tsham drag po las kyis tshar gcod mdzod// bstan par dad can bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams// dgra byed bar chad kun las rnam rgyal nas// tshe dang bsod nams rnam dkar phrin las dang*// yon tan gong 'phel srung skyob ma g.yel cig

/dngos brgyud bla ma lha yi byin rlabs dang*// bstan srung dam can mthu rtsal cher grags pa'i// bden stobs nus pas ji ltar bcol ba'i las// thogs med bsam don myur du 'grub gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la las bcol bstan dgra'i snying dmar 'byin pa'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di'ang dgos pa'i skabs byung du/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa bi dza yantu// // ༄༅// lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ shlau ka gcig 'di sngar gyi bstod rnying zhig go /ma mo'i gtso mo rdo rje rab brtan ma// ma rungs 'dul byed smug nag srin mo'i gzugs// ma ltar brtse bas bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong*// ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod// 'dod pa'i khams kun dbang sgyur mthu che yang*// dngos brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung bran bzhin sgrubs// chos dang chos mdzad skyong la snying nye yang*// dam nyams srog gi gshed mar gyur khyod kyi// phyag g.yas ral gri bstan dgra gsod phyir 'phyar// g.yon pas gdug can snying khrag 'thung snod thogs// mchan g.yon ci 'dod dbyig gi na ku las// dam tshig ldan pa'i ci 'dod re ba skong*// rma bya'i gdung skyob gtsug mdzes srin mo'i gzugs// stod smad zhing lpags re lde'i sham bus dkris// mgo phreng rus rgyan dbyug pa gsum gyis bsgos// 'phrog byed dug can zung gis snyan char byas// lcags sgrog rgyan gyis sgeg pa'i zhabs gnyis po// mi lpags kyis bkab drel rta'i steng na rol// rnam 'dren bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe'i phyir// nyin mtshan kun du rgyu bar byed ma la// klu chen

'di'ang sngon gyi bstod rnying zhig go/ thod dkar klu bdud nag la sogs// chu srin gdong can ba lang dred sna ma// khri snyan sa le dkar sngo dmar ser rnams// pho nya rab 'jigs du mas bskor la bstod// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bcas pa'i bkas// bstan pa'i bka' srung chen mor gnyer gtad ltar// dngos brgyud bla ma'i bka' lung gus mnyan cing*// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i// bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// rdo rje rab tu brtan ma 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma sogs spyi ltar brjod do// zhes rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa 'di/ sde dge ban tshang mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
